items.Sentence: Wastewater flow to the evaporation basins shall not exceed 50,000 gallons per day.
A surface aerobic environment shall be maintained in each basin. The dissolved oxygen content in the upper zone (one foot) of the evaporation/percolation ponds shall not be less than 1.0 mg/L.
Groundwater elevation determinations around the leachfields used for handwashing wastewater disposal shall be performed using piezometers installed at each leachfield.
